ReportModal.submittedDesc: Your report has been submitted for review.

HelpModal.title: How to convert to free parking
HelpModal.desc: Gray means Unknown and stays visible in both views. Red meters list payment hours; they do not establish permission to park.
HelpModal.redLines: Red lines are paid or restricted.
HelpModal.doubleCheckDesc: Read all posted signs and entrance conditions before parking. The map does not observe vacant spaces.
HelpModal.betaDesc: This app is under active development. Please expect occasional issues.
HelpModal.evidenceDesc: Free parking needs current authoritative rules for the location, time and vehicle. Legacy map data does not verify free permission. Driver Warnings are dated observations and never change a rule.
